description: This file defines the 'Article' class in the Conduit.Domain namespace, representing articles with properties like Title, Body, Author, Comments, Tags, and Favorites, along with computed properties.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Represents a blog or news article with metadata, author, comments, tags, and favorite status.

methods.name: Favorited
methods.description: Returns true if the article has any favorites.

methods.name: FavoritesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of favorites for the article.

methods.name: TagList
methods.description: Returns a list of tag IDs associated with the article.
